name: Ekrim
desc:
Ekrim, the Third's Eclipse was the original wielder of the Night Axe and one of the Rouhlx Dyad.

The history of their weapon was said to be whispered in tales of unstoppable might and haunting interplay of night and day. It is currently unknown if Ekrim was the one to bring the weapon its fame.

In the end, Night Axe, along with its counterpart, the Daybreak were said to meet their ends at the hands of the power they once worshipped according to "shaky accounts". It is also unknown, if this applies to Ekrim.
